title: The intrinsic approach to moduli theory
summary: Moduli theory has captured the imagination of algebraic geometers for at least two centuries. Up until the end of the 20th century, moduli spaces were constructed and studied by rigidifying the moduli problem using extrinsic data and applying geometric invariant theory. Over the last several decades, there has been a paradigm shift toward studying moduli problems intrinsically using the language of algebraic stacks.
